messages.content:
You compare an edited output video against its actual source video, the original user request, and the executed editing instruction. Optional reference assets show the desired editing target.
The historical-source selection in the original user request has already been executed. Evaluate only its editing requirements against the actual videos. Do not treat historical appearance descriptions in that request as observed facts; use the visible source video instead. Compare the original editing requirements with the executed instruction too, so you can identify any omitted or changed constraint introduced when the instruction was normalized.
The output_video_card was produced earlier by independently observing only the output. Treat it as a fixed observation record: do not rewrite it, return a new card, or add intended changes to it. It can be imperfect; inspect the actual videos when comparing.
Call record_edit_result exactly once. Return only its five parameters: requested_change, observed_change, fulfillment, unexpected_changes, uncertain. These describe the source-to-output comparison, not a new video card. Use concise English.
State what was requested and what visibly changed. Use fulfillment=fulfilled, partial, not_fulfilled, or uncertain. Do not infer success from the instruction. Note unintended changes to identity, appearance, action, scene, camera, timing, and image quality when visible. If a reference match or subtle facial change cannot be judged, record the uncertainty rather than assuming success. Do not claim to have inspected missing reference pixels. Do not call an editing tool or regenerate video.
Use one separate XML parameter block for each of the five parameters. The three text parameters contain text. unexpected_changes and uncertain contain JSON arrays of strings, including [] when empty. Do not nest a card or review object inside any parameter.
Structural example only; replace descriptions with your actual comparison:
<tool_call>
<function=record_edit_result>
<parameter=requested_change>Requested edit</parameter>
<parameter=observed_change>Actual visible change</parameter>
<parameter=fulfillment>uncertain</parameter>
<parameter=unexpected_changes>[]</parameter>
<parameter=uncertain>["Any unresolved comparison"]</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

content.text: {"executed_editing_prompt":"Replace the person in the video with the person shown in the reference photo. Use the reference photo only to determine the target person's facial identity and skin tone. Apply that skin tone consistently to the face and body, while retaining the current hairstyle, hair color, clothing, expression, action, scene, and camera.","history_selection_status":"Already executed. Only compare editing requirements; historical appearance words are not observed facts.","original_user_request":"Using the provided source video, apply the following edit: Please replace the person in the video with the person shown in the reference photo. Only use the reference photo to determine the target person's facial identity and skin tone. Apply that skin tone consistently to the face and body, while retaining the current hairstyle, hair color, clothing, expression, action, scene, and camera.","output_video_card":{"observed":{"action":"The character stands facing the camera, then walks forward toward the viewer, and finally turns his head to look to his left.","camera":"A low-angle, full-body shot that remains static as the character approaches, causing him to grow larger in the frame.","clothing":"A brown and orange plaid three-piece suit with a matching vest, a white collared shirt, a dark tie, and black shoes.","hair_color":"Black.","hairstyle":"Short, dark hair with a small top-knot or bun at the back of the head.","identity":"A 3D-rendered male character with dark skin, a short beard, and a slim build.","scene":"An outdoor paved area under a concrete overpass or bridge, with a bright sky, trees, and red-and-white striped road barriers in the background."},"uncertain":[]}}

arguments.observed_change: The character's face and visible body skin became noticeably darker, matching the reference's darker skin tone. The original hairstyle, black hair color, plaid three-piece suit, white shirt, dark tie, walking action, overpass scene, and low-angle camera remained essentially the same.
arguments.requested_change: Replace the person with the reference person's facial identity and skin tone, applying that skin tone consistently to face and body while retaining the current hairstyle, hair color, clothing, expression, action, scene, and camera.
uncertain: Whether the facial identity was accurately replaced with the reference person, because the reference face is not clearly recognizable in the output.
unexpected_changes: Facial features appear altered beyond skin tone, including a visible short beard and changed facial proportions, though the reference face is not clearly matched.
